text: Taking the egg with `take egg` gained 5 points (score 0->5).
Opening the window with `open window`, then entering with `enter window`, gained 10 points on entry to the Kitchen (score 5->15).
Descending through the opened trap door with `down`, while carrying the sword, gained 25 points when reaching the Cellar (score 15->40).
Taking the painting with `take painting` gained 4 points (score 40->44).

The death was caused by carrying the painting when trying `climb chimney`; after dropping it, the thief appeared, and attacking him twice with the sword ended in death. Death reduced the score from 44 to 34.
Moving the leaves revealed a grating, but `open grating` reported that it was locked; no way to unlock or enter it was found.
`open egg` did not work: the game said you had neither the tools nor the expertise, so the egg was never opened.

The Studio chimney could not be climbed while carrying other items. After dropping the sword, sack, egg, garlic, and sandwich so that only the lantern was carried, `climb chimney` succeeded and reached the Kitchen.
The west wooden door looked like an exit, but it was described as nailed shut and was never opened.
The steep metal ramp looked like a route upward, but `climb ramp` failed because it was impossible; it was never climbed.
Pouring water on the garlic with `pour water on garlic` only spilled and evaporated the water; no useful garlic result was achieved.

The lantern was not in the Kitchen; it was successfully taken and lit in the Living Room before entering the dark cellar. It needed to be carried through dark passages, but was later dropped in the Studio.
The final death was caused by dropping the lit lantern in the Studio, then entering the dark passage west from the Gallery and moving in darkness until a grue devoured you.

Defeating the troll with repeated `attack troll with knife` commands, then moving east into the East-West Passage, gained 5 points. The sword had been left in the Studio, so the troll was defeated with the knife instead.
Saying `echo words`, then taking the revealed platinum bar with `take platinum bar`, gained 10 points.

After carrying lunch and garlic through the failed chimney attempts, dropping them caused the thief to leave after robbing you; the thief encounter was triggered before those items were safely dealt with.

The death was caused by wandering until the lantern burned out: the lamp became nearly out in the Chasm, then `light lamp` reported it was burned out, and entering darkness led to the grue. The root cause was failing to preserve or replace the light before continuing.
Dropping the platinum bar at the Dam Base and leaving it there was a setback; later, after the thief passed through the Loud Room, the bar could no longer be taken there.

Pushing blue, yellow, brown, and red buttons first raised the water from ankles to knees; continuing with yellow, brown, and red raised it to the neck. The flooding blocked the north exit and led to drowning in the Maintenance Room.
The sluice-control bolt and green bubble looked promising, but `turn bolt with wrench` and `turn bolt with screwdriver` never worked, and pushing or examining the bubble produced no useful result.
The folded plastic boat looked promising, but it was never inflated: no pump was found, and attempts such as `inflate pile with tube` and `inflate pile with pump` failed.
The crack looked like a possible route, but `enter crack` repeatedly reported that it was too narrow; it was never entered.

The dark staircase looked like a route, but climbing it without the lantern only entered darkness and was immediately abandoned; the Kitchen-to-attic route was instead reached by climbing the chimney.

The death was caused by repeatedly pushing the yellow, brown, and red buttons after the water had reached knee level; the water rose to the neck, the north exit was blocked, and you drowned. The root cause was continuing to flood the room instead of leaving after the first button sequence.
The group of tool chests looked promising, but no command to open or examine them was attempted.
The matchbook labeled "Visit Beautiful FCD#3" looked promising, but it was never taken or examined.
The scramble-down route from the dam looked promising, but it was never attempted.
